ems_esp_cs6800i.json.source: Entity registry and states of a Bosch Compress CS5800i/CS6800i (EMS-ESP product 8) with K40RF via EMS-ESP MQTT discovery, Home Assistant 2026.10.4, read on 2026-10-27.
ems_esp_cs6800i.json.real: entity ids, unique ids (platform mqtt), units, device and state classes, activity values seen ('aus', 'Heizen', 'Warmwasser', 'Abtauen'; EMS-ESP language German). Old (3.6) and current (dhw_) names exist side by side with identical values.
ems_esp_cs6800i.json.made_up: every state value (meter readings, starts, temperatures, powers).

bosch_homecom_k40.json.source: Entity registry and states of a Bosch Compress CS5800i/CS6800i with K40RF via bosch_homecom 1.6.0 (data source local and cloud), Home Assistant 2026.10.4, read on 2026-10-27.
bosch_homecom_k40.json.real: entity id pattern (without the area prefix the owner's installation has), unique id keys (platform bosch_homecom), units incl. the wrong 'L/min' of the volume flow, device and state classes, which entities bosch_homecom disables by default.
bosch_homecom_k40.json.made_up: the gateway id and every state value.

luxtronik_lwd70a.json.source: Derived from the source code of luxtronik2 (BenPru/luxtronik) 2026.10.18 on 2026-10-27 (sensor.py, binary_sensor.py, sensor_entities_predefined.py, binary_sensor_entities_predefined.py, const.py, config_flow.py); not read from a real installation.
luxtronik_lwd70a.json.real: unique id format '<domain>.<prefix>_<key>' (unique id = original entity id, platform luxtronik2), prefix pattern 'luxtronik_<serial>', keys, entity domains, units incl. 'L/h' and '∑', device and state classes, entities disabled by default, the options of the status enum.
luxtronik_lwd70a.json.made_up: the serial in the prefix, the model and every state value.

stiebel_isg_wpmsystem.json.source: Derived from the source of stiebel_eltron_isg 2026.10-beta4 (15b8b30) and pystiebeleltron 0.8.0, WPMsystem (WPM family), no real installation; read on 2026-10-27.
stiebel_isg_wpmsystem.json.real: unique id format and keys (platform stiebel_eltron_isg), units, device and state classes, entities disabled by default; entity ids follow the German names via has_entity_name.
stiebel_isg_wpmsystem.json.made_up: config entry id, every state value; subset of the entities.

stiebel_isg_lwz.json.made_up: config entry id, every state value; subset of the entities.

heishamon_wh_mdc07j3e5.json.source: Derived from the source code of kamaradclimber/heishamon-homeassistant 2.12.1 (domain aquarea, commit 086c1a9) and the HeishaMon MQTT topic list, read on 2026-10-27; not from a real installation (experimental).
heishamon_wh_mdc07j3e5.json.real: unique id format and keys (platform aquarea), entity ids for the default MQTT prefix panasonic_heat_pump/, integration-sensor names, units, device and state classes, enum options, which entities aquarea disables by default.
heishamon_wh_mdc07j3e5.json.made_up: the config entry id, the heat pump model and every state value.

lambda_eu08l.json.source: Derived from the source code of lambda_heat_pumps 2.8.6 (GuidoJeuken-6512/lambda_heat_pumps, commit 5ad6cd0) on 2026-10-27; no real installation.
lambda_eu08l.json.real: unique id and entity id format (legacy names, entry name 'EU08L'), keys, units, device and state classes, register attributes and option lists as the code builds them; all entities enabled by default.
lambda_eu08l.json.made_up: every state value; the selection of entities (a subset of one heat pump, plus hc1/boil1 decoys).

idm_navigator20.json.source: Derived from the source code of Xerolux/idm-heatpump-hass 0.23.2-b4 (commit 385f8cc, 2026-10-26) and idm-heatpump-api 2.14.5b2: iDM Navigator 2.0 with Modbus TCP and web interface (PIN). Not read from a real installation.
idm_navigator20.json.real: unique id format '<entry_id>_<key>' and keys, platform idm_heatpump, units and state classes as the integration sets them, enum labels of hp_operating_mode.
idm_navigator20.json.made_up: entry id, entity ids (slugified German names, device 'IDM'), every state value; the field 'source' (modbus/web/web statistics) is a test aid.

vicare_vitocal250a.json.source: Derived from the source code of Home Assistant core vicare (dev 8f785c4, 2026-10-28; entity.py, sensor.py, binary_sensor.py, strings.json, tests/components/vicare/snapshots) and PyViCare 2.63.0 test data (tests/response/Vitocal250A.json); an E3 heat pump, not read from a real installation.
vicare_vitocal250a.json.real: unique id format '<gateway>_<device>-<key>[-<component>]' (platform vicare), keys incl. those with spaces, entity domains, units, device and state classes, entities disabled by default, the compressor phase vocabulary of E3 controllers (setPhase enum, '-' replaced by '_').
vicare_vitocal250a.json.made_up: gateway and device serials, the model name in the entity ids, every state value; subset of the entities.

vicare_vitocal333g.json.source: As vicare_vitocal250a.json, with PyViCare test data Vitocal333G(-with-Vitovent300F).json and the HA snapshot of Vitocal222G_Vitovent300W: a Vitotronic heat pump without energy features.
vicare_vitocal333g.json.real: as vicare_vitocal250a.json; the Vitotronic phase vocabulary (setPhase enum of Vitocal 300-G/333-G), the DHW charging binary sensor.
vicare_vitocal333g.json.made_up: serials, the model name 'Vitocal_333G' in the entity ids, every state value; subset of the entities.
